name: Officier Volkham
source:
A friendly and upbeat new recruit, Volkham is thrilled to work alongside his/her veteran partner, Shearsmith. Eager to learn, Volkham isn't afraid to ask questions, which, unfortunately, causes friction with Shearsmith. Despite this, Volkham tries his/her beat to put a smile on her new partner's face.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/thegraveyardshift]Itch.io[/url]]
